children.text: We take on a small number of matters at a time, so every client works with the attorney who knows their case.
You will hear from us before you have to ask, and you will always know what comes next.
The firm opened with one attorney and one promise: to explain the law in plain words and to return every call.
Today the practice is larger, and the promise is the same.
